span.label: DELAY ACTIVITY - NEURAL ACTIVITY THAT PERSISTS DURING THE RETENTION INTERVAL OF DELAY TASKS, reconsidered as to WHAT IT IS, WHERE IN THE BRAIN IT IS FOUND, WHAT ROLES IT SERVES AND HOW IT MAY BE GENERATED

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Structured recurrent excitation with tuned excitation–inhibition balance lets network spiking settle into a self-sustaining attractor state that keeps the memory alive without input
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Slow NMDA-receptor excitation stabilises attractor networks so that persistent spiking can be maintained over seconds
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Encoding-driven changes in synaptic weights turn the network into a matched filter, so the memory is stored silently and revealed when noisy input is fed through it
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Feedforward connections between similarly tuned cells relay brief bursts of spiking along a chain, storing information without any single cell firing continuously
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Long-range input (from thalamus) is required for local cortical circuits to sustain delay activity at all
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the definition is widened deliberately and its price is named in the same sentence: THIS EXPANDED DEFINITION ALLOWS FOR A MORE INCLUSIVE AND COMPREHENSIVE EVALUATION OF DELAY ACTIVITY, BUT AT THE SAME TIME CALLS ATTENTION TO THE CHALLENGE OF COMPARING DATA ACROSS DIFFERENT EXPERIMENTAL METHODS, BRAIN REGIONS AND SPECIES
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and the one design that escapes the problem: WE ADDRESS THIS ISSUE BY HIGHLIGHTING STUDIES THAT RECORD DELAY ACTIVITY ACROSS MULTIPLE BRAIN REGIONS IN THE SAME EXPERIMENT

span.label: a code that cannot be read from its parts: Quotation withheld AND INSTEAD ARE ENCODED IN THE COMBINED ACTIVITY OF SEVERAL NEURONS

span.label: DELAY ACTIVITY IS SEEN MORE GENERALLY IN CONTEXTS THAT REQUIRE AN ORGANISM TO LINK A SENSORY STIMULUS TO A DELAYED BEHAVIOUR, SUCH AS DURING TASKS OF SUSTAINED ATTENTION OR DECISION MAKING; HERE, HOWEVER, WE EXAMINE DELAY ACTIVITY IN TASKS EXPLICITLY TESTING WM, WHERE IT HAS BEEN CHARACTERIZED MOST EXTENSIVELY
span.note: what this limits: the attribution of delay activity to working memory: DELAY ACTIVITY IS SEEN MORE GENERALLY IN CONTEXTS THAT REQUIRE AN ORGANISM TO LINK A SENSORY STIMULUS TO A DELAYED BEHAVIOUR, SUCH AS DURING TASKS OF SUSTAINED ATTENTION OR DECISION MAKING

span.label: The broad definition the review adopts makes comparison across methods, regions and species harder.
span.note: what this limits: every comparison the review makes under its own definition: it ALLOWS FOR A MORE INCLUSIVE AND COMPREHENSIVE EVALUATION ... BUT AT THE SAME TIME CALLS ATTENTION TO THE CHALLENGE OF COMPARING DATA ACROSS DIFFERENT EXPERIMENTAL METHODS, BRAIN REGIONS AND SPECIES
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AS THE RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN THE BIOPHYSICAL PROPERTIES OF NEURONS OR MICRO-SCALE NETWORKS AND THE EFP OR BOLD SIGNALS IS INCOMPLETELY UNDERSTOOD, BIOPHYSICAL MODELS ALMOST EXCLUSIVELY ATTEMPT TO DESCRIBE SPIKING ACTIVITY; ACCORDINGLY, WE FOCUS OUR DISCUSSION HERE ON DELAY SPIKING
span.note: what this limits: the coverage of the biophysical modelling literature: AS THE RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN THE BIOPHYSICAL PROPERTIES OF NEURONS OR MICRO-SCALE NETWORKS AND THE EFP OR BOLD SIGNALS IS INCOMPLETELY UNDERSTOOD, BIOPHYSICAL MODELS ALMOST EXCLUSIVELY ATTEMPT TO DESCRIBE SPIKING

span.label: A CODE THAT CANNOT BE READ FROM ITS PARTS: NONLINEAR MIXED SELECTIVITY ENABLES INDIVIDUAL NEURONS TO RESPOND TO COMBINATIONS OF TASK AND STIMULUS FEATURES SUCH THAT FEATURE COMBINATIONS CANNOT BE READ OUT FROM THE RESPONSES OF THE INDIVIDUAL NEURON ALONE AND INSTEAD ARE ENCODED IN THE COMBINED ACTIVITY OF SEVERAL NEURONS. A per-neuron tag cannot carry what the population encodes

span.label: Stable firing across the delay is the exception rather than the rule: in one lateral prefrontal cortex study only 3% of delay-active neurons maintained a constant spike rate for the whole delay.

span.label: Cortical delay activity depends causally on long-range thalamic input: optogenetically silencing thalamic delay activity in mice disrupted frontal delay activity and impaired delayed-discrimination behaviour.

span.label: Thalamic delay activity is not a copy of the cortical signal — it is less content-selective than frontal delay activity yet causally sets frontal selectivity.

span.label: Which region shows delay activity depends on the animal's strategy: a prospective motor strategy raised prefrontal delay activity while a retrospective sensory strategy raised it in posterior cortex.

span.label: A continuous-attractor prediction was confirmed in monkey lPFC: how far population delay spiking drifted predicted how large the behavioural error was.

span.label: Blocking prefrontal NMDA receptors abolishes delay spiking in non-human primates, confirming the modelled role of slow NMDAR excitation in sustaining persistent activity.
